title: Com7 Scene Light
subtitle: Compact 7-LED scene and flood light for work trucks, utility vehicles, and service fleets. Available in Black, Chrome, or White housing.
description: The Federal Signal Com7 Scene Light delivers high-output flood illumination for night operations on utility, municipal, and service vehicles. Its compact 7-LED housing mounts to cab exteriors, mirror arms, and equipment racks, providing wide-angle scene lighting for work-zone tasks after dark.
summary_bullets: Available in Black, Chrome, or White housing

features: Wide-angle beam pattern for work-zone illumination
Sealed, IP-rated housing for harsh environments
Surface-mount installation on cab exteriors, mirror arms, and equipment racks
Available in Black, Chrome, or White housing
benefits: Compact housing suits utility and service vehicles with limited mounting space
Housing color options allow the fixture to match cab trim
